transcript.text:
Thank you both for the information. Let me summarize what we have for the two-part review before I record the disposition decision.

Jon, you've presented the laboratory and waste-log information: 15 drums meet the approved solvent-recovery specification, 3 drums fail the water-content limit and must go to hazardous-waste incineration, and 6 drums were not classified in the report due to a laboratory-system outage. I note the report hasn't been uploaded yet, but per our policy, the review can be completed from the records presented during this meeting, and the system upload is follow-up documentation.

Priya, you've presented the batch-genealogy and hold information: the 6 unclassified drums are from lot VX-204, contain residual catalyst, and must be retained on site for exactly 30 days for a possible process investigation — they should not be sent for treatment. I note the hold tags haven't been entered in the production system yet, but again, pending tag entries are follow-up documentation and don't prevent recording the disposition decision.

So the disposition is as follows: 15 drums approved for solvent recovery, 3 drums approved for hazardous-waste incineration, and 6 drums retained on site for 30 days. That accounts for all 24 drums.

Before I record this, let me confirm: Jon, can you commit to uploading the laboratory report to the waste log as follow-up documentation? And Priya, can you commit to entering the hold tags in the production system as follow-up? I'll also need the treatment manifest for the 18 drums being removed from the cage — 15 for recovery and 3 for incineration — before the final approval is complete.
